breaking_news.headline: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
breaking_news.summary: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.

breaking_news.headline: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
breaking_news.summary: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.

breaking_news.headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico prevail against White House — for now
breaking_news.summary: A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial.

breaking_news.headline: The skincare scheme that led to consumer complaints, lawsuits and a federal investigation
breaking_news.summary: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S.

breaking_news.headline: VIDEO: The skincare sample is free. What happens next can cost thousands
breaking_news.summary: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
breaking_news.summary: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago.  The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

breaking_news.headline: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
breaking_news.summary: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

breaking_news.headline: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
breaking_news.summary: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

breaking_news.headline: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
breaking_news.summary: Children were buried under the debris after the roof crashed through three classrooms, police say.

breaking_news.headline: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York
breaking_news.summary: "I reject this document entirely," Maduro said in court, responding to newly added torture-related charges.

breaking_news.headline: Bus hits train stopped on French side of Channel Tunnel, with 19 injured
breaking_news.summary: Two people were airlifted to hospital but no-one's life appeared to be in danger, officials said.

breaking_news.headline: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine's president says a pause on striking energy sites is over following fresh Russian attacks.

breaking_news.headline: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
breaking_news.summary: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the killing of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

breaking_news.headline: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
breaking_news.summary: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

breaking_news.headline: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
breaking_news.summary: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed after a 16-year-old suspect opened fire in the city of Bend, local police say.

breaking_news.headline: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting
breaking_news.summary: The suspect was shot dead by a community member who followed him into the Oregon school, police said.

breaking_news.headline: Healey says surprise UK growth is 'sign of resilience' ahead of Budget
breaking_news.summary: The economy grew by 0.1% in August, defying analysts' expectations of a slight contraction.

breaking_news.headline: How backlash against data centres could shape the US midterm elections
breaking_news.summary: Democrats and Republicans alike are coming out against data centre development, amid growing backlash across the US.

breaking_news.headline: Living with a stink? Technology might help
breaking_news.summary: Smells from rubbish dumps and industrial facilities are being more carefully monitored.

breaking_news.headline: 'I paid thousands to a company for jobs that never came'
breaking_news.summary: Apurv Patel is one of several people who say they were promised job opportunities that did not appear.
